title: 第一百三十二章 老怪物们第一百三十一章 了因果进天命
content_zh:
第一百三十二章老怪物们
萧凉吐出一口浊气，他的修为，稳固在天命境初期。
对于走纯粹剑修之路的他来说，而今进入天命境之后，反而没有了门槛。
只是前面的路，走得艰辛了些，若是没有那些机缘，没有“无量剑道”，他一步一步往前，就算是给他三十年的时间，也不会有今日之成就。
事实上，很多东西其实都与气运有莫大的关系，只是气运之说向来又虚无缥缈。
纵然苏清绾是天机楼的楼主，对于所谓的命数天运，她能看见的，依旧只是些许天机。
修为越深，越是发现天机深不可测，许多东西，都充满了不确定性。
“恭喜你，进入了天命境，从此你便是剑仙了。”苏清绾走过来，脸上泛着温和笑意。
今日还真是一波三折，但到目前为止，一切都是朝着好的方向走的。
萧凉在洞幽境巅峰的时候，便可败天命境巅峰的绝顶高手，而今萧凉要杀寻常天命境巅峰的高手，易如反掌。
这就是纯粹剑修的恐怖之处。
镇北王姬临风也走过来，他眼中泛起温和之色，“萧帅知道你今日的成就，他一定会为你高兴的。”
萧凉淡然一笑，进入天命境之后，他的心态已然发生了翻天覆地的变化，仿佛看什么都能够淡定自若。
镇北王转身，看向王柏，道：“这趟浑水，其实王家没有必要掺和进来，只是人心不足蛇吞象，你们要的，终究太多了。”
“成王败寇，但是你们想要对付我王家，还是需要付出些代价的，琅琊王家的根基，也不是你们能明白的。”
王柏声音里面，透着无以形容的孤傲。
萧凉淡淡说道：“王家的底蕴的确深厚，但是一个世家要倒下，不管他传承多久，也是避免不了的。”
“他们不能代表我王家。”
就在这时，一青年走了过来，他是王家的异变双灵根天骄王书恒。
“王家的主，他们还做不了，从现在开始，我先不王柏和王宣不再是王家的人，就此开出族谱。”

他的声音里面，透着一股无以形容的霸道气息。
王宣和王柏面色微微一变，王柏冷哼一声，道：“我才是王家家主。”
“从现在开始，你不是了。”王书恒淡淡说道。
“小辈，你知道自己在说什么吗？”王宣厉声喝道，掌间聚力击向王书恒而去。
王书恒冷哼一声，眉心之处，一点光芒亮起，王宣的力量瞬间被破开，那一点光芒击在他的心口之处。
嗤的一声，鲜血飞溅，他整个人便倒在了地上，眼睛睁得大大的，显然是死不瞑目。
“你不是我王家的人，你究竟是谁？”王柏面色不住变化，此时他在王书恒的身上感知到一股无以形容的力量，那是来自血脉的压制，此外，还有他不可形容的恐怖力量。
“看来王家到了这一代，的确落幕了，好在老夫如今苏醒过来。”王书恒的声音，透着一股老气横秋。
王柏心神猛地一颤，眼中神色不住变化，整个人身子在不住颤抖。
甚至，王柏此时已然没法子站着，哐当的一声，陡然跪在了地上。
那种压制，让他额头之处，不住有细汗冒出来。
第一百三十二章老怪物们
萧凉此时也看得出来，此时的王书恒，像是身体里面还住着一个人。

Chapter 132: Old Monsters
Xiao Liang exhaled a breath of turbid air. His cultivation was firmly at the early stage of the Destiny Realm.
For him who has followed the path of pure sword cultivation, now that he has entered the destiny realm, there is no threshold.
It's just that the road ahead is a bit more difficult. If he hadn't had those opportunities and the "Infinite Swordsmanship", he would have moved forward step by step. Even if he had been given thirty years, he would not have achieved what he has today.
In fact, many things are closely related to luck, but the theory of luck has always been illusory.
Even though Su Qingwan is the owner of the Tianji Building, she can still only see a little bit of the so-called destiny.
The deeper you cultivate, the more you discover that the secrets of heaven are unfathomable, and many things are full of uncertainty.
"Congratulations, you have entered the realm of destiny. From now on, you will be a sword immortal." Su Qingwan walked over with a gentle smile on her face.
Today has been full of twists and turns, but so far, everything is going in a good direction.
When Xiao Liang was at the peak of the Dongyou Realm, he could defeat the top masters at the peak of the Destiny Realm. Now, it was easy for Xiao Liang to kill the average masters at the peak of the Destiny Realm.
This is the horror of pure swordsmanship.
Zhenbei Wang Ji Linfeng also came over, with a gentle look in his eyes, "Shuai Xiao knows what you have accomplished today, and he will definitely be happy for you."
Xiao Liang smiled calmly. After entering the destiny realm, his mentality had undergone earth-shaking changes, as if he could look at everything calmly and calmly.
The King of Zhenbei turned around, looked at Wang Bai, and said, "In fact, there is no need for the Wang family to get involved in this muddy water. It's just that people's hearts are not enough, and what you want is too much after all."
"Succeed as a king or lose as a bandit, but if you want to deal with my Wang family, you still need to pay a price. The foundation of the Langya Wang family is not something you can understand."
There was indescribable arrogance in Wang Bai's voice.
Xiao Liang said lightly: "The Wang family's heritage is indeed profound, but if a family falls, it cannot be avoided no matter how long it has been passed down."
"They cannot represent my Wang family."
At this moment, a young man walked over. He was Wang Shuheng, the genius of the Wang family with mutated double spiritual roots.
"They can't be the head of the Wang family yet. From now on, I won't draw up a family tree until Wang Bai and Wang Xuan are no longer members of the Wang family."
There was an indescribable aura of dominance in his voice.
Wang Xuan and Wang Bai's expressions changed slightly. Wang Bai snorted coldly and said, "I am the head of the Wang family."
"From now on, you are no longer." Wang Shuheng said lightly.
"Junior, do you know what you are talking about?" Wang Xuan shouted sharply, and he focused his palms to attack Wang Shuheng.
Wang Shuheng snorted coldly, and a little light lit up between his eyebrows. Wang Xuan's power was instantly broken, and the little light hit his heart.
With a sneer, blood spattered, and he fell to the ground, his eyes wide open, obviously unwilling to die in peace.
"You are not from my Wang family, who are you?" Wang Bai's expression couldn't help changing. At this time, he sensed an indescribable power in Wang Shuheng's body, which was the suppression of blood. In addition, there was also his indescribable terrifying power.
"It seems that the Wang family has indeed come to an end in this generation. Fortunately, I have woken up now." Wang Shuheng's voice revealed an old-fashioned air.
Wang Bai's heart trembled suddenly, the expression in his eyes kept changing, and his whole body couldn't help trembling.
In fact, Wang Bai could no longer stand at this time, and suddenly knelt on the ground with a clang.
That kind of suppression made sweat break out on his forehead.
Chapter 132: Old Monsters
Xiao Liang could also see at this time that Wang Shuheng seemed to have someone living in his body.
